name: @truss-harness/control-center
description: Standalone multi-workspace agent coordination preview for Truss.
author: Truss Contributors

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild ./dist/main.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=./dist/main.cjs && esbuild ./dist/preload.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=./dist/preload.cjs && esbuild ./dist/renderer.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=./dist/renderer.bundle.js && node ./scripts/copy-static.mjs
